text:
Maria Chen: Hi finance — submitted an expense for 2026-03-10, international taxi (CDG -> hotel). Corpcard charged vendor and I also paid tip in cash, so I split the txn. Uploaded what vendor sent but they only provided a single PDF that is not itemized. Requesting reimbursement for the cash tip.
Finance Bot: Expense 1780-332 flagged: missing itemized receipt for vendor 'Paris Taxi Services'. Please provide itemized receipt or manager approval.
Maria Chen: The driver gave a handwritten slip but it blurred on scan. Vendor says they only issue a single non-itemized invoice. I attached the vendor PDF + my card statement screenshot and the handwritten pic.
Samir Patel: @Maria Chen can you also add a short note in the expense explaining the situation and include Google Maps route screenshot? That helped us before for international taxis.
Maria Chen: Added note and attached route screenshot. Also pinging my manager for approval — @Jess Ortega can you approve the tip reimbursement?
Jess Ortega: Approving — saw the photos and the card statement matches. Approve reimbursement for €12 tip. :thumbsup:
Finance Bot: Received manager approval from Jess Ortega. Reminder: finance still needs either itemized invoice or manager sign-off for tips; manager sign-off accepted here.
Liam Wu: Quick question for records: was the exchange rate used the bank rate or personal conversion? We need the converted USD amount for the report.
Maria Chen: Bank conversion used by corpcard shows $14.32 for the tip on the statement. I added that as the reimbursable USD amount in the expense form.
Finance Bot: Expense 1780-332 marked ready for payment. ETA reimbursement: next payroll run (2026-03-24). If you need faster, submit a manual ACH request.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — noted the payroll ETA. Will follow up if ACH needed.
